name: 文字の書体と配置
prompt:
Refine LH16-0002 using the supplied images. Keep the panel and content; correct only type scale/position and utility icon stroke.

REFERENCE ROLES
Image 1 is attempt 1. Preserve its exact Japanese strings, font field, two distinct controls, white surface and 366:174 aspect ratio.
Image 2 is the exact localized target and controls all positions, sizes, and neutral strokes.
Image 3 is the original source. Preserve the real alignment and line-spacing concepts as two distinct utility icons.

MAKE THESE CORRECTIONS
- Keep the canvas exactly 366 × 174 px (or the identical aspect ratio).
- Heading 「文字の書体と配置」: x=16, y=16, w=334, h=28, Meiryo Bold 20 px / 28 px line height. The first candidate made it too large and set it too low.
- Label 「書体」: x=16, y=60, Meiryo Regular 12 px / 16 px line height.
- Font field at x=16, y=88, w=234, h=40; center 「メイリオ」 within the field, Meiryo Regular 14 px / 24 px line height.
- Buttons at x=260 and x=310, y=88, each 40 × 40 px with thin, light-neutral borders.
- Alignment and line-spacing glyphs stay at 20 × 20 px, with thin gray 1.5 px strokes, not thick black strokes. Keep the first as four varied horizontal alignment lines; keep the second as three lines with vertical spacing arrows.

PRESERVE
White background, exact Japanese copy, neutral ink, existing order and generous empty space. Keep the two controls separate and unmistakable.

EXCLUDE
No English labels, no Canva editor chrome, no gradients, no new fields, no extra icons, no shadows or decoration.
reviewNotes: Parent approved exact candidate; see private digest-bound approval.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
